title: SLO Resonance Mapper and Regional Traffic Quarantine Workflow
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Build instrumentation and dashboards to detect and visualize correlated SLO violations across regions (SLO resonance), then provide an operational quarantine workflow that can isolate noisy routes/tenants to protect global SLOs and enable graceful regional failover.

Motivation: We observe recurring multi-region ripples where a low-volume but high-cost route in one region causes admission pressure and KV cache thrashing that cascades into other regions minutes later. Current dashboards show per-region p99 and admit rates separately, but operators lack a way to quickly identify cross-region correlations and to simulate/exercise quarantine actions (traffic quarantine = automatic route/tenant isolation + fallback routing) from the Console.

Scope:
- Instrumentation: add a lightweight SLO-resonance signal derived from correlated p95/p99 spikes, admit-rate divergence, batch-size distribution shifts, and KV-hit ratio deltas across regions.
- SLIs: token-latency p50/p95/p99 per-route and per-tenant; admit_rate; kv_hit_rate; batch_size_avg; admission_backpressure_score.
- Dashboards: (1) Resonance heatmap: cross-region correlation matrix with time-lagged peaks; (2) Temporal resonance stream: stacked event timelines with inferred root-region and propagation path; (3) Quarantine panel: list of candidate routes/tenants with risk score, one-click simulate, one-click quarantine + rollback; (4) Canary replay: synthetic traffic toggle to validate quarantine impact.
- Runbook & automation: author a quarantine playbook integrated with existing failover policies and the runbook service; include alerting thresholds and automated canary for low-risk quarantine actions.

Out of scope for this ticket: full RBAC governance UI for quarantine (will be follow-up with PM/SEC), private deployment wiring for on-prem (separate Private deployment task).
acceptance_criteria: Resonance metric implemented and emitted to metrics pipeline (prometheus histogram + traces link) for at least 2 representative routes.
Resonance heatmap dashboard shows cross-region correlation and time-lag visualization for historical 72h window.
Quarantine panel lists top-10 candidate routes by risk score and supports simulate and apply actions against a staging region.
End-to-end test: simulate a noisy-route scenario in the chaos lab and demonstrate quarantine reduces cross-region p99 violations by >50% in the protected region.
Documentation and runbook published (Console runbooks and ops playbook link in comments).
tasks: Define resonance metric formula and thresholds (work with SRE and Metrics team).
Add telemetry hooks in admission controller to emit per-route admit_rate and admission_backpressure_score (low overhead).
Extend KV cache telemetry to emit region-level kv_hit_rate deltas and batch_size histograms.
Build Grafana/Console panels: resonance heatmap, temporal stream, quarantine candidate list, canary replay controls.
Implement quarantine API: mark-route-quarantine, simulate-quarantine, rollback-quarantine (does not include RBAC).
Create chaos-lab script and runbook test case for noisy-route injection and quarantine validation.
Create unit and e2e tests for telemetry correctness and quarantine API safety checks.
Coordinate with PM for Console UX copy and with Design for quarantine panel mockups.

notes: Implementation constraint: resonance computation must run in the metrics pipeline (not in hot path of request) to keep admission controller lightweight.
Risk: over-aggressive quarantine could impact customers unexpectedly. Mitigation: simulate, canary and timebound auto-rollback by default; require manual confirmation for high-impact routes.
Next steps after completion: add RBAC gating, expose quarantine audit events to Console audit logs, and wire Private deployment governance.
